headline: PSEi extends rebound on BSP rate signal
summary: The PSEi rose 1.93 percent to close at 5,456.14 after the BSP signaled it could take a less aggressive approach to raising rates as growth slows.
why: The Philippine Stock Exchange index tracks the country's largest listed companies, and central bank rate policy shapes local borrowing costs and equity valuations.
why_moved: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas signaled a less aggressive approach to raising interest rates as economic growth slows, extending the stock rebound.
